schedule.name: cosine_without_restarts
schedule.applied_to: both Muon and auxiliary Adam, relative to their own initial LR
schedule.evidence: prospective common protocol choice; stability under this complete schedule not yet empirically established

training.interpretation: same fixed 20000-update comparison as Heat; not demonstrated convergence

tuning.score: mean across 3 seeds of each seed median validation relative L2 at 19000,19500,20000
tuning.auxiliary_adam_policy: select each architecture pure-Adam LR first, then fix it in that architecture hybrid groups and tune only Muon LR
tuning.interpretation: staged one-dimensional search, not joint optimization of two learning rates
tuning.boundary_policy: if a finite optimum is at either grid endpoint, extend outwards by a factor of 3 in that direction, one new LR x all 3 original tuning seeds per round; continue until bracketed or outward candidate diverges; no test access; extras beyond 135 recorded
tuning.grid_tie_policy: exact equal finite scores: smaller initial scanned learning rate wins; record ties
tuning.all_invalid_policy: if no candidate has all 3 finite valid scores, no learning rate is selected and the affected configuration/dependent hybrid search is left unresolved; never select an infinite score

formal.reason: 10 fresh common seeds across all configurations avoid recycling seeds used to select LR
formal.evaluation_checkpoint: model at fixed T, not best-test or best-validation checkpoint
formal.main_table: mean and sample SD across 10 valid seed test errors; if any seed fails, mark full-10 summary unavailable and report failures plus a clearly labelled successful-runs-only descriptive summary
formal.paired_CI: primary: two-sided 95% paired-t CI on log-scale interaction across seeds; secondary log optimizer contrasts and original-scale differences
formal.interaction: I_s=ln(E_full_muon_s/E_full_adam_s)-ln(E_noflow_muon_s/E_noflow_adam_s), natural logarithms; E is final-T mean per-function test relative L2
formal.target_time: Descriptive validation thresholds .06 and .045 kept for the shared reporting convention; first logged crossing every 500 updates; never used for checkpoint or LR selection.
formal.seed_policy: 10 new seeds, no reuse of tuning seeds; same seeds for all 9 configurations
formal.run_order: seed outer loop 292..301; all 9 configurations reach terminal success/failure status before next seed
formal.within_seed_order: cycle through protocol groups, shifted left by (seed-292) modulo 9; deterministic and logged
formal.incomplete_seed_policy: no seed replacement; no model before T substituted for failed final checkpoint; terminal failures are reported and do not block completing other configurations in the same seed
formal.evaluation_gate: default after all planned runs reach terminal statuses and all hyperparameters are frozen; if infrastructure stops the campaign, an explicitly logged partial export may score only completed whole-seed blocks, caching each T-step model once; partial inference exploratory and never used to stop/change later runs
formal.partial_reporting: completed full seed blocks may be exported after infrastructure interruption; disclose n and reason, no claim of complete planned n=10, no test-driven decision to continue/stop/change protocol

failure_handling.numerical_divergence_definition: NaN/Inf in training loss, gradients, model parameters, model outputs or validation metric; a large but finite error is not automatically classified as divergence
failure_handling.tuning: stop that numerical run, retain logs/last valid checkpoint, assign mathematical selection score +infinity; if any of the 3 tuning seeds diverges at an LR, that LR mean score is +infinity; do not replace seed or retry with altered settings

infinite_score_serialization.reason: stored separately; selector explicitly maps this status to +infinity, never treats it as a missing seed

failure_handling.formal: retain original seed, LR and failed status; no replacement seed, no post hoc rescue LR, no substituting last valid model for the T-step model; report failure counts out of 10 per configuration
failure_handling.missing_terminal_test_error: failed runs have no T-step test evaluation; no fabricated/capped error or artificial log ratio is inserted
failure_handling.infra_interruption: power, process interruption or transient I/O is not numerical divergence; resume the same run from its complete checkpoint and retain the cause/history
failure_handling.zero_test_error: a nonpositive or nonfinite error cannot be used in the log contrast; report the exact value/status and leave affected inferential contrast unavailable rather than silently adding epsilon
failure_handling.primary_inference_if_failure: primary I analysis requires valid positive final errors for all 4 QOFN configurations in each of all 10 planned seeds; otherwise report primary full-10 inference unavailable/not yet complete as planned. Any available-complete-seed analysis is explicitly exploratory with exact n and failed or incomplete seed IDs
failure_handling.secondary_contrasts: each paired contrast requires its participating models; incomplete contrasts follow the same unavailable-primary/exploratory-subset labelling rule

statistics.error_definition: E_arch,opt,seed = arithmetic mean across 200 test functions of per-function relative L2 for the frozen T-step model
statistics.optimizer_direction: negative Delta means Muon-Adam lower error; exp(mean Delta) is geometric mean error ratio; percent reduction = 100*(1-exp(mean Delta))
statistics.primary_estimand: mean across 10 planned fresh seeds of I_s = Delta_full,s - Delta_noflow,s
statistics.interaction_direction: negative I means a stronger proportional error reduction from Muon-Adam in Full than in No-Flow

primary_test.name: paired t test comparing Delta_full and Delta_noflow
primary_test.equivalent: one-sample t test of I_s against 0
primary_test.normality_assumption: independent seed contrasts with approximately normal mean inference; assumptions stated, not established by n=10
primary_test.zero_variance_rule: if all I_s are identical, flag zero sample variance and report t-based inference unavailable rather than manufacture a finite standard error; retain descriptive contrast and the separately defined Wilcoxon result

sensitivity_test.name: Wilcoxon signed-rank test of I_s against 0
sensitivity_test.zero_tie_rule: remove exact zero contrasts; for n<=10 enumerate all sign assignments of nonzero absolute midranks, preserving ties; if all contrasts zero report statistic=0 and p=1
sensitivity_test.role: sensitivity, not a second primary test; always report beside t test, never choose smaller p
sensitivity_test.assumption: symmetric paired-difference distribution under null; not assumption-free

statistics.secondary_original_scale: D_abs_arch,s = E_arch,Adam,s - E_arch,MuonAdam,s; I_abs = D_abs_full - D_abs_noflow; positive means larger absolute Muon benefit; opposite improvement sign convention from log ratio is stated
statistics.secondary_scope: other architecture optimizer contrasts, output-projection control, absolute contrasts and time-to-target are secondary/exploratory; primary significance claim is based only on the prespecified t test of I
statistics.unit_warning: test functions and the 3 terminal validation checkpoints are not independent seed replicates
statistics.tuned_protocol_limit: each configuration has its own validation-selected LR; I describes the tuned protocol, not a shared-LR pure mechanism effect

time_to_target.predeclaration: Retained from the heat reporting convention and fixed before any new Burgers model training; descriptive thresholds, not an assertion that they are equally difficult for both PDEs.
time_to_target.event: first scheduled checkpoint, including step 0, with unsmoothed mean per-function validation relative L2 <= threshold
time_to_target.interpolation: none; report first observed crossing and sampling interval, not an exact continuously observed crossing
time_to_target.primary_clock: cumulative active per-run wall seconds including validation, diagnostics and checkpoint I/O; exclude queue waits and time when run is stopped/offline
time_to_target.secondary_clock: cumulative forward+loss+backward+optimizer seconds at the crossing
time_to_target.not_reached: if a successful run reaches T without crossing, record event=false and right-censor at its actual active wall time at T; do not impute target time=0 or extrapolate
time_to_target.diverged: record numerical failure and failure time separately; a divergence before target is not ordinary successful-run right-censoring. Retain any earlier observed crossing together with later failure status; do not label it a successfully completed training run
time_to_target.summary: per threshold and configuration report reached/10, failed/10, non-reached-success/10, raw event/censor times, and conditional median among reached runs labelled as such; do not compare conditional medians without these counts

scope: Forced periodic viscous Burgers: u_t + (u^2/2)_x = .1 u_xx + f(x), x in [0,1), t in [0,1]
origin: PDE-specific prospective extension of the completed heat protocol; not retrospective preregistration

data.query_order: t,x; x varies fastest, no heat target-order repair
data.preprocessing: training-only min-max with one extra coordinate for QOFN; raw two-function inputs and periodic trunk features for dense baselines; no PCA
data.test: new 200 functions generated with independently recorded GRF/amplitude seeds before any Burgers training; legacy test never opened; model access only after all frozen final runs are terminal

architectures.selection: Input-compatible symmetric Burgers branches fixed before training. Dense widths chosen using parameter counts only, within 1% of DeepONet; p=25, ReLU.
architectures.qofn_normalization: Full and No-Flow share norm clamp 1e-12 and exactly the same train-fitted preprocessing
architectures.optimizer_allocation: QOFN Hybrid: three dense output matrices use Muon, other parameters Adam. Dense Hybrid: every 2D weight Muon, biases Adam. Output-only DeepONet Hybrid: two output matrices Muon, all others Adam.

scientific_limits: PDE-specific staged learning-rate selection; no transfer of selected heat rates.
Two distinct PDE studies; no pooled error or pooled seed test.
No requirement of a negative or significant Burgers interaction.
Reference targets follow the audited original finite-volume recipe and snapshot timing; three-sample refinement is not a continuum accuracy certificate.
The new test set has no model-selection exposure within this campaign; legacy training generation seeds were not stored.
